idea-plugin.name: GH Stack
idea-plugin.description:
A thin IntelliJ wrapper around the GitHub CLI gh stack extension. View and navigate stacked pull requests without leaving the IDE.

  • View the current stacked PR chain in the Git tool window, or in a dedicated GH Stack tool window; the view refreshes automatically as branches and Git state change
  • See each layer's PR number, plus its merged / queued / needs-rebase status and the current branch
  • Check out a specific layer
  • Add a branch on top of the stack
  • Initialize a new stack
  • Rebase the stack (whole, upstack, downstack, or without trunk), then continue or abort
  • Optionally stash uncommitted changes and untracked files around a rebase (ask / always / never)
  • Prompt to enable git rerere before initializing or rebasing a stack, so repeated conflict resolutions are reused
  • Switch between locally tracked stacks
  • Show clear next steps when gh or the gh stack extension is missing, or the current branch is not in a stack
  • Configure the gh executable path in Settings | Tools | GH Stack

Requires GitHub CLI, gh extension install github/gh-stack, and a signed-in account (gh auth login).
